Rumors about the next-generation Apple TV 4K have long suggested that the new device will feature a more modern chip to support Apple Intelligence features. But the latest leak, discovered by Aaron Perris, indicates that its chip will be more powerful than expected.

Leaked code reveals that the upcoming Apple TV 4K will feature an A19 or A19 Pro chip

We have been waiting for a new generation Apple TV 4K for a long time — longer than at any other point in the product's history.

There were originally rumors that the new model would launch in 2025, with evidence suggesting it would feature an A17 Pro chip. That chip is currently the minimum requirement to support Apple Intelligence, so it would make sense, and it would also be a significant upgrade over the existing A15 Bionic.

However, according to Aaron Perris, the next-generation Apple TV 4K will feature a better chip than expected. He wrote:

We discovered an upcoming Apple TV model from Apple, designated AppleTV18,1

razmsu's top comment

I just want the remote to make a sound when I'm looking for it. That's all, please.

The "18,1" designation is similar to Apple's identification codes for last year's iPhone 17 lineup. Some iPhone 17 models use the A19 chip, while the iPhone Air and 17 Pro models use the A19 Pro.

Whether it's the A19 or A19 Pro, it's quite a significant upgrade for the Apple TV. But I suspect the A19 Pro is more likely to be used, because that chip exclusively supports Siri AI's most powerful features.

Siri AI is expected to be one of the headline features of the next-generation Apple TV 4K. Considering how long it has been since the last hardware update, I would expect Apple not to release a new model that's missing some AI features.

Are you planning to buy the next-generation Apple TV 4K? Let us know in the comments.
